verdict.rationale: Fin's own Procedures and workflows run autonomously, handling multi-step customer queries end to end and taking actions in external systems. Insights also continuously analyzes conversations without user involvement. However, these automations are triggered by incoming customer conversations; the evidence shows no user-defined background jobs, recurring schedules or event-triggered automation builder beyond titles. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring background automations, documented workflow trigger and configuration details, hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Procedures let you train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish.
